title: Group by key
prompt:
Write `GroupBy[T any, K comparable](items []T, key func(T) K) map[K][]T` that groups items by `key(item)`. Items in a group keep their input order. Empty input gives an empty map, not nil.

Grouping reviews by rating: `[{Great 5} {Bad 1} {OK 5}]` → `{5:[{Great 5} {OK 5}] 1:[{Bad 1}]}`
hint: `append` to a missing key works, because `m[k]` gives a nil slice.
